title: Free LLM API Hub, field-level change feed (/api/v1/changes.json)
description: Field-level changes to the tracked provider fields, mined from the git history of data/providers.json and grouped by ISO week, newest first. Each week is the item with the same guid in /changes.xml. Contract v1: fields are only added within v1, so consumers must ignore fields they do not know; a field named here is never renamed, removed or retyped in v1.

version.description: The dataset release version (SemVer), the same as in every other file of /api/v1/.

generated.description: The date of the last dataset change, as in every other file of /api/v1/.

schema.description: The URL of this schema. Added in dataset 2.16.0.

page.description: The public page that shows the same changes month by month. Added in dataset 2.16.0.

feed.description: The RSS feed with one item per week of this file. Added in dataset 2.16.0.

fields.description: The tracked provider fields, in order, each with its human label. A change to a field not listed here is not in this file. Added in dataset 2.16.0.

window_weeks.description: How many ISO weeks the file covers, ending at the week of the newest change (never anchored on the current date). Weeks with no change are omitted. Added in dataset 2.16.0.

count.description: The number of field changes in the file: the sum of count over weeks. Added in dataset 2.16.0.

weeks.description: One entry per ISO week with at least one change, newest first.

count.description: The number of changes in the week; equals the length of changes.

changes.description: Newest first, then by provider name, then in the order of fields.

date.description: The commit date of the change to data/providers.json.

slug.description: The provider. A provider that has left the dataset keeps its slug, which is never reused.

name.description: The provider's current display name, or its slug if it has left the dataset.

field.description: The provider field that changed: one of the field values of fields.

from.description: The value before the change. commercial_ok is projected to boolean or null as in every v1 provider object.

to.description: The value after the change, projected the same way.

label.description: The human label of field, as the feed and the page show it. Added in dataset 2.16.0.

commit.description: The git commit of the repository that made the change, or null when it is not known. A squash or rebase merge can give the same change a new commit, so do not use it as a stable identifier. Added in dataset 2.16.0.

title.description: The title of this week's item in changes.xml. Added in dataset 2.16.0.

summary.description: The description of this week's item in changes.xml: each provider with the labels of the fields that changed. Added in dataset 2.16.0.

guid.description: The guid of this week's item in changes.xml. Added in dataset 2.16.0.

providers.description: The slugs of the providers with a change in the week, in the order of changes. Added in dataset 2.16.0.
